Dirty dishes
Oct 2026 • Friends
Trip advisor says CHAN is best restaurant in Hue. My hotel disagreed but went anyway due to reviews. It was terrible. Filthy with dishes stacked in bins everywhere. No vibe and few customers. We made two. Mistakes, going to Chan and two not walking out.
Written October 7, 2026
Dong Phuong Nguyen
Dear Tara,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience, and we're truly sorry your visit to Chạn fell short of what you expected, especially after choosing us over your hotel's advice.

You are right to point out the dish bins. Used dishes should never be left in view of our guests, and on the day of your visit our team did not clear them away quickly enough. We have addressed this directly with our staff to make sure it does not happen again.

We're sorry the atmosphere didn't feel right for you either. If you ever return to Huế, we would sincerely welcome the chance to show you a different Chạn. Please reach out to us directly by message our facebook page at: fb.com/chancomnieuhue before your visit.

Warm regards,
Dong Phuong Nguyen,
Owner
Chạn Restaurant

Vietnamese restaurant first choice
Sep 2026 • Friends
The best dining experience in Vietnam, better than the two Michelin restaurants I've had in Hanoi, and the price was very nice 👍, around 60 yuan per person.
Food/Taste: The dishes are very unique, featuring many local specialties of Shunhua, and the taste is great. Chinese palates can be quite picky, but this experience was surprisingly wonderful.
Service: best! The service is very good. Both the girl at the front desk and the girl who taught us about the food were very attentive and patient, and they were smiling and cute, which was very healing for our tiring trip. (The front desk is Tháo)
Environment: best! The chopsticks have paper sleeves, the dining table has wet wipes, the bathroom has ice cubes, and it is odorless with a special scent of lemongrass.
Suggestion: Perhaps consider operating a Chinese app? There are quite a few Chinese tourists here.

Supplement: I found this store on Chinese apps (Xiaohongshu and Dianping).
